latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — AI-powered free music generator for videos and images.

- Upload your video or images and generate AI background music to match your content.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM and other common formats (up to 500MB).
- Automatic 1080p MP4 export for easy sharing.
- Simple chat interface: just describe the mood or prompt for music generation.
- No copyright issues and built for fast, hassle-free content creation.
- Free credits with anonymous sign-in; seamless session and cloud GPU processing.
